provenance.method: Bounded review of current Acas performance-management guidance and its reasonable-adjustment boundary.

name: Acas performance management and reasonable adjustments
description: Acas guidance for workplace performance processes that explicitly addresses reasonable adjustments where disability may be relevant.
intended_use: Understanding the process questions to ask when performance concerns, support needs and disability-related barriers overlap.
audience_or_context: Employees and employers in Great Britain; employment law in Northern Ireland differs.
limitations: General Acas guidance is not individual legal advice and does not decide whether a process or dismissal is fair.
Northern Ireland employment law and advice routes differ.
